mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refunds (order_id, users_id, reason, status, requested_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{usersrId}, #{reason}, #{status}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT r.refunds_id, r.order_id, r.users_id, r.reason, r.status, r.requested_at, r.processed_at, o.order_number FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.users_id = #{usersrId} ORDER BY r.refunds_id DESC
